summary: Constructor-style initializer: calls DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain on `this` with size literal 0x10 and flag 2, then installs the vtable pointer off_5ADD0C at offset 0x0 of `this`. Returns the initialized object. Differs from sibling constructors in the size/flag literals and installed vtable.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0x10u, 2) to construct the base DirectX texture object with a mipmap chain.
Write the vtable pointer off_5ADD0C into the first DWORD of `this` (offset 0x0).

unresolved: Meaning of the size literal 0x10 and flag literal 2 passed to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain is not established here.
Object type owning the vtable off_5ADD0C is unknown; construction is only reachable from DirectXTextureSurfaceFactoryDispatchingFourCCCod (0x0050B8A9).
Size/flag literal pair differs from sibling constructors; significance of these different literals is unverified.
Semantics of argument a2 are unconfirmed; plausibly a creation/params descriptor.
